text:
auditor_claire: Hi team — auditor request: for SOC 2 control CC7 we need proof of access log retention and any authz policy changes around the 2025-04-02 outage window. Can you provide a minimal reproducible export and chain-of-custody for the logs?

morgan_sre: sure — we have retained access logs in s3://redwood-audit/access/YYYY/MM/DD/*.gz. Which exact time window does the auditor want?

auditor_claire: thanks. Window = 2025-04-02 01:00:00 UTC -> 2025-04-02 05:00:00 UTC. Also need to know the sampling method (full vs sampled), TTLs, and whether any KMS/HSM key rotations happened within 30 days prior.

sasha_netsec: FYI we did a scheduled keystore rotation on 2025-03-20 (kek-rot-2025-03-20) but we did not rotate HSM material; KMS key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01. rotation_date: 2025-03-20T12:05:00Z.

ryan_devops: For the export playbook, run:```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/access/2025/04/02/ ./ --recursive --include "*20250402*" --exclude "*metadata*"
# then gzip -d and tar up the subset for chain-of-custody
```

support_jen: auditor also asked for repro of the API 503 observed in the same timeframe. We have one request_id: req-20250402-7a9c. The traces are in X-Ray under trace id: 1-6534abcd-7ef01234.

auditor_claire: we need a short playbook to reproduce the issue or confirm that the exports include the exact req_id and auth headers scrubbed — auditors want the original headers for correlation, but redacted PII is fine. Provide redaction method.

morgan_sre: repro steps (non-prod):
1) set HEADERS=("Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" "x-request-id: req-20250402-7a9c")
2) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" -H "x-request-id: req-20250402-7a9c" "https://api.redwood-inference.prod/generate?model=default"
If you need the exact payload we used, use the attached sample payload below. In prod we won't re-issue the exact token — we'll simulate with a scoped test token and include the original x-request-id for correlation.

sasha_netsec: redaction method: we run the export through a scrubbing script that replaces Authorization, Cookie, and user_email fields with SHA256 digests and stores the mapping in a separate manual-only artifact. Example command:```
python tools/scrub_logs.py --input ./access.log --output ./access.scrubbed.log --redact-keys Authorization,Cookie,user_email --keep-mapping ./coc/mapping-20250402.csv
```

auditor_claire: please include the mapping file (encrypted) in the chain-of-custody bundle and note who has access. Also need evidence that the retention policy (S3 lifecycle) is enforced: show the lifecycle configuration and an example object lifecycle tag in the bucket for 2024/2025 logs.

ryan_devops: lifecycle config snippet:```
{
  "Rules": [
    {"ID": "audit-retain-2yrs", "Filter": {"Prefix": "access/"}, "Status": "Enabled", "Transitions": [], "NoncurrentVersionExpiration": {}, "Expiration": {"Days": 730}}
  ]
}
```

morgan_sre: attaching a sample object metadata line from S3 head-object (redacted):```
Key: access/2025/04/02/access.log.gz
LastModified: 2025-04-02T06:12:03.000Z
StorageClass: STANDARD
Metadata: {"retention":"730d","origin":"ingest-proxy-3"}
```

auditor_claire: good. Also need proof that the audit logs were not tampered with after ingestion (hash chain or signatures). Do we have a signing process?

sasha_netsec: yes — we sign each daily rollover file with the HSM-backed key and store detached signature under coc/signatures/YYYY-MM-DD.sig. Example verify command:```
kms-cli verify --key-id abcd-ef01 --signature coc/signatures/2025-04-02.sig --file access-2025-04-02.tar.gz
```

support_jen: I can produce a tarball that contains: access.logs (scrubbed), signatures, mapping (encrypted), lifecycle config, KMS rotation log snippet, and a short README with instructions to verify.

auditor_claire: please include chain-of-custody entries that show who packaged the bundle and ACLs on the S3 object. Also need the ticket that requested the rotation on 2025-03-20 and the change approvals.

ryan_devops: ticket link: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-3248|OPS-3248> — includes approver list and rollout notes. I'll export the approvals PDF.

morgan_sre: prep checklist for delivery:
- export subset (2025-04-02 01:00 -> 05:00) ✔
- scrub logs and generate mapping (mapping encrypted) ✔
- signatures present ✔
- keystore rotation ticket & KMS rotation evidence ✔
- lifecycle config + sample head-object ✔
- replay/repro steps for req-20250402-7a9c ✔
- chain-of-custody manifest with ACLs ✔

auditor_claire: timeline expectation: can you upload the bundle to the auditor S3 placeholder and DM me the presigned link by EOD 2025-04-07? If you can't meet EOD, give ETA.

morgan_sre: aiming EOD 2025-04-07. If blocker arises will update by EOD 2025-04-06.

sasha_netsec: one more note: the HSM key is not exported; auditors can verify signatures via the detached sigs and KMS verify logs — include KMS Verify event sample from CloudTrail for 2025-04-02.

auditor_claire: perfect. Last ask: include a short sentence in the README that explains our sampling policy when traffic spikes — i.e., by default we ingest 100% and only sample when ingestion lag > threshold, how it's flagged and how to reconstruct.

morgan_sre: added to the README: "Default ingestion = 100%. Sampling enabled when ingestion-lag > 120s; sampling algorithm = head-drop with 1:10 sampling by user-id hash. Reconstruct using prefix/KV replay stored in prefix 'ingest-cache/'"

auditor_claire: thanks team — please DM me the presigned link when uploaded. :thumbsup:
